about_the_game:
Ride with the emblematic jerseys of previous Tour de France thanks to the Team Visma | Lease a Bike Pack and try to reproduce the exploits of the famous cycling team. This DLC contains 3 complete kits:

The Masterpiece: Special 2022 Tour de France jersey from the Team Visma | Lease a Bike
The Vélodrome: Special 2023 Tour de France jersey from the Team Visma | Lease a Bike
The Renaissance: Special 2024 Tour de France jersey from the Team Visma | Lease a Bike
